## Palantir Stock Flagged as Stretched Even After Record Earnings Print

PLTR is a bellwether for enterprise AI adoption sentiment; if the market won't re-rate it even on record results, it signals valuation ceilings are tightening for high-growth AI software—a broader read-through for positioning in the vertical AI software basket.

- Simply Wall St analysis argues PLTR appears overvalued even following a record earnings result.
- The framing implies the earnings beat is already priced in and the current multiple embeds a high bar for future growth.
- No specific valuation ratio, earnings figure, or price target is cited in the headline.
- Adds to a pattern of valuation caution on AI-native software names following strong results.
